title: RLS Filter
text: 使用 RLS 自适应滤波器算法，针对给定输入和期望信号计算滤波输出、滤波器误差和滤波器权重，输入 5 路、输出 3 路；按 {Initial input variance estimate} 指定初始输入协方差估计；{Filter length} 指定 FIR 滤波器系数向量的长度、{Specify forgetting factor via} 指定遗忘因子、{Forgetting factor (0 to 1)} 指定 RLS 遗忘因子、{Initial value of filter weights} 指定 FIR 滤波器权重的初始值、{Adapt port} 启用 Adapt 端口、{Reset port} 启用 Reset 端口、{Output filter weights} 输出滤波器权重，按实例取值。

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Desired
ports.summary: 期望信号 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Lambda
ports.summary: 遗忘因子 scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: Adapt
ports.summary: 用于更新滤波器权重的选项 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: 滤波后的信号 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Error
ports.summary: 输出与期望信号之间的差值 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Wts
ports.summary: 自适应滤波器权重 scalar | column vector

params.name: Filter length
params.values: FIR 滤波器系数向量的长度 32 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Specify forgetting factor via
params.values: 指定遗忘因子 Dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Forgetting factor (0 to 1)
params.values: RLS 遗忘因子 1.0 (default) | scalar in the range [0,1]

params.name: Initial value of filter weights
params.values: FIR 滤波器权重的初始值 0 (default) | vector

params.name: Initial input variance estimate
params.values: 初始输入协方差估计 0.1 (default) | scalar | square matrix

params.name: Adapt port
params.values: 启用 Adapt 端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Reset port
params.values: 启用 Reset 端口 None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Output filter weights
params.values: 输出滤波器权重 on (default) | off
